title: Model Evaluation Part 5 - Model Metrics Trend

cues.en: Next, we're going to define a method to calculate how the model's performance metrics have changed over time, with the default lookback period of 30 days.
cues.zh: 接著定義方法，計算模型效能指標隨時間的變化，預設回溯期間是 30 天。

cues.en: So right there we can say async define get underscore model metrics trend.
cues.zh: 用 async def 定義 get_model_metrics_trend。

cues.en: That's going to take in self.
Then the model ID that's going to be of type Uuid.
Then the days that's going to be an integer.
cues.zh: 還有 int 型別的 days。

cues.en: And our lookback period is going to be 30 days.
Then this function is going to return a list of dictionaries.
And for the dictionaries they're going to have keys of strings and values of any.
cues.zh: 字典的鍵為 str，值為 Any。

cues.en: Then first let's set the end date to the current date and time by saying end date.
cues.zh: 先把 end_date 設為目前日期與時間。

cues.en: That's going to be date time.
That's now passing in the time zone.
Then let's set the start date to the end date minus the number of days specified.
cues.zh: 再把 start_date 設為 end_date 減去指定天數。

cues.en: As you can see, the start date that's going to be the end date minus Timedelta with the days being
cues.zh: start_date 等於 end_date 減去 timedelta，days 使用，

cues.en: the days passed into this function as an argument, which in our case is going to be 30.
cues.zh: 傳入函式的 days 參數，這裡預設是 30。

cues.en: Then let's add a list to store the metrics for each day.
cues.zh: 再建立串列，儲存每天的指標。

cues.en: As you can see, metrics trend that's going to be an empty list.
Then we can set the current date to the start date by saying current date.
That's going to be the start date.
Then we're going to loop through each day in the specified period by saying, while the current date
cues.zh: 用迴圈逐一處理指定期間的每一天；while current_date，

cues.en: is less than or equals to the end date, then we're going to set the start and end of the day by saying the day underscore start.
cues.zh: 小於等於 end_date，接著設定當天起點與終點，先設定 day_start。

cues.en: That's going to be the current date.
Replace the R and set that to zero.
Then minute and set that to zero.
And then second I'll set that to zero.
Then microsecond and set that to zero.
Then we're going to set the end of the day to the start of the next day, minus the microseconds, because the end date is not included in the date range.
cues.zh: 當天終點設為隔天起點減去一微秒，講者說明這是因為日期範圍不包含結束日期。

cues.en: As you can see for the day end, that's going to be day start plus time.
cues.zh: day_end 等於 day_start 加上 time，

cues.en: Delta.
And you can see days is equal to one minus time Delta pass in microseconds.
cues.zh: days 設為 1，再減去 timedelta，傳入 microseconds。

cues.en: And set that to one.
Then we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 接著建立 try 區塊。

cues.en: Within the try block, we're going to get the metrics for this day using the evaluate model performance method that we defined before.
cues.zh: 呼叫先前定義的 evaluate_model_performance，取得當天指標。

cues.en: As you can see daily metrics that's going to be await itself dot evaluate model performance.
And to that method we're going to pass in the model ID which is going to be the model ID.
Then the start date that's going to be day start.
And then the end date that's going to be day.
And then if you have model predictions for the day we're going to add the metrics to the metrics train list.
cues.zh: 如果當天有模型預測，就把指標加入 metrics_trend 串列。

cues.en: And so you can say if daily metrics then we're going to get the key of metrics and total predictions.
cues.zh: 檢查 daily_metrics 裡 metrics 的 total_predictions。

cues.en: So if that is greater than zero then we're going to add the metrics to the metrics trend list by saying metrics trend.
We're going to append to that list a dictionary with the key of date.
cues.zh: append 一個字典，第一個鍵是 date。

cues.en: The date is going to be the start date string format time.
And we're going to say that's going to be the year, month and day just like that.
cues.zh: 格式設為年、月、日，像這樣。

cues.en: Then the next key is going to be matrix.
That's going to be daily matrix.
Then passing the matrix.
Then for this try block we have to have the except block right there.
cues.zh: 這個 try 也需要 except 區塊，就放在這裡。

cues.en: We can say except exception as e.
Then in case of any exceptions we're going to handle and log any errors that occurred during the evaluation.
cues.zh: 如果發生例外，就處理並記錄評估期間的錯誤。

cues.en: So you can say logger dot error.
And in instincts we can say error getting metrics for then passing the day stat dot date like that.
cues.zh: f 字串寫「取得當天指標時發生錯誤」，帶入 day_start.date()。

cues.en: Then the error like that.
Then we're going to move to the next day by seeing the current date.
cues.zh: 接著移動到下一天，設定 current_date。

cues.en: That's going to be plus equals to the time delta and days is equals to one like that.
cues.zh: 用 += 加上 timedelta，days 設為 1。

cues.en: Then we can return the collected daily metrics by having the return statement at the same level as the while loop, which is right there.
cues.zh: 最後傳回收集的每日指標，return 要和 while 迴圈同一層，就在這裡。

cues.en: We can return the metrics trend like that.
Good.
And that's it for the lecture.
In the next lecture we shall add more methods to our model evaluator class.
